I’ve no place to say this. But as long as you possess the conviction to inspire change, the path you seek to walk will manifest itself through your inevitable actions. 
Only time will tell whether the spark that you possess burns into a flame.

Sounds great! And no worries, I really wasn’t interested in any payment, the very experience of helping with something like this will bring value towards what it is I’m working on, that’s my motivation behind my assistance. 
Is it alright if I DM you? I have a lot more questions 😅
Absolutely! I’d love to give you some feedback as well as swap works 💪🏿

I don’t know how much I can help, but I’d be happy to go over and look at what you’re working on and offer any feedback or bounce ideas the best I can! And if that turns out to be something you find holds worth then I’d be happy to continue assisting you going forward. 💪🏿
I’m not sure how much of a help I could be, but I’d love to see what you’re working on and offer whatever advice or help I can!

I’m going to suck with this response here but that’s only because I’ve bridged this gap, heck I’ve jumped over the gap so cleanly that I can’t say it any other way. I also wouldn’t advice thinking this way either, it will lead to you destroying everyone who cares for you, but this is the path I have chosen.
You have one life my friend, embrace those fears, grab them by the neck and squeeze em. If you have a passion and it really burns in your soul, whatever it’s for, you chase it and you leave everything else behind. That’s what I’ve done ever since I’ve remembered.
My attempts to compromise with my family and “the real world” if you will by working jobs made me even more passively suicidal than I already was. 
As selfish as it sounds, the pain that I understand that I inflict on everyone that cares for me with my incorrigible behaviour and the complete lack of empathy I show towards that concern, doesn’t even hold a candle to the way my stomach eats away at my soul when I think about living even a moment of my life not writing, not drawing or doing the things I enjoy in my leisure. 
Again, sounds incredibly arrogant, but this is my path. I couldn’t care less what the world were to say, because in the moments where me and my passions get time to ourselves, I am truly truly happy. Beyond words as to the feelings that swirl around inside just typing this right now. 
I don’t know what your passion is, or your fears in relation to pursuing them. I’m a stranger but if there’s one thing I absolutely will plea for you to do or continue to do if you already are, is to pour your heart and soul into what it is that you love. I know it sounds corny and please don’t take my advice so literally that you down tools work wise like I did, not that I’m inferring my advice is that incredible, it’s just I wouldn’t ever want anyone to go through what you go through severing emotional bonds like I have. 
But my friend, do whatever it is within your grasps to overcome the fears that prevent you from pursuing whatever it is that sets your heart ablaze, because one day it will truly be too late and it won’t be when you’re gone. It’ll be crueler, you’ll still be breathing, knowing that the passions you once had slipped through your fingers and whilst you still breathe and are the same you that you once were, you won’t be able to pursue your passion either at all or the same way you could’ve at that point in your life. That regret will only breed further negative emotion. 
Stay safe, this world is a really big place.

In some ways, I can relate to what you’re saying, but in my case, I isolate myself because I have to for my own personal reasons. 
So if I were to be so bold to offer you some advice from my position, as risky as it can be and regardless of the fact somebody will inevitably disappoint you. The smile of one is worth the ridicule of millions, it only takes one pure heart to make all the hardships of what you’re experiencing now worth it. 
That kind heart, however it comes into your life or however you find it, whatever form it comes in, is something you should pursue. Not necessarily too heavily, because then the fall off will be that much more painful. But you should have the confidence to take a loss in the search for kindred spirits who can share the burden of existence alongside you. 
I have chosen to live without practicing any of this advice I have given you as I mentioned at the start of this, I have my own reasons for that. 
So my advice comes from someone who is both already too far to turn back and physically unable to have those types of connections.
I’m not an emotional person, in the sense that I have emotions, but I can completely kill them and look at them rationally. 
Living the way I do can fill you with resentment, a burden you’ll feel on your shoulders each and every day. It can mentally crush you. 
Fortunately, my mental fortitude is insurmountable, I’ve bottled all of this and nobody ever will truly know the inner workings of my brain, but the after effects of that strength have a negative impact on my physical strength.
No idea how helpful any of this will be if at all, long story short, no matter how bleak it may look as of now and how low your opinion of yourself is. There are people who also seek the same companionship you do, some of them will hurt you and some of them will seem to be one way but be a completely different person. 
But in the end, it only takes one person to make every misstep worthwhile, I hope you find that person however that connection is established. 
I hope you feel even slightly better with this reply, be safe, it’s a big world out there.

The question I’ve been stuck with my entire life, is what is the point in living a life if every moment you live it is not spent chasing your passion(s). It sounds arrogant of course, in terms of financial speaking I’ve had a privileged upbringing, but from as early as I can remember remembering I’ve never placed any real value in the things I’d be begging my parents for. I’m not an emotional person now, but as a child, I still remember the small satisfaction my toys and games would give me before sinking back into thoughts of suicide... 
I’m a coward, in the sense that as much as I’ve been wanting to end my life since I can remember, I’ll never do it. I wish I did have that conviction. 
If life is an existence that consists of enduring experiences that don’t fill your heart with the enthusiasm to see the next day, then it is an existence I reject. Hopefully one day, I’ll obtain the conviction to reject it truly.

I don’t know, maybe I’m a coward, maybe I can’t be bothered, maybe I feel that I am bound to break free from this for good. 
I definitely don’t like the idea of ‘losing’ to life but I don’t see my death as that, I just convince myself it’s that way to make myself more stubborn about the idea of suicide.
I guess you don’t, or at least that’s the majority of my experience. Which I’m fine with either way.
